origin.name: Noto Sans Mono Regular 2.014
origin.author: The Noto Project Authors
origin.note: The debug-overlay face. UNMODIFIED release artifact, member 'NotoSansMono/hinted/ttf/NotoSansMono-Regular.ttf' of the official NotoSansMono-v2.014 release zip, byte-identical to notofonts.github.io. This family's latest release is 2.014 while Noto Sans is at 2.015; they are released independently from the same repository and the version skew is upstream's, not a mistake here. MEASURED: it carries no glyph for U+00AD, and every one of the 190 characters the descriptors ask for advances exactly 600/1000 em despite post.isFixedPitch being 0. See docs/font-provenance.md.

assets.notPackaged: a typeface, not an asset. The .spritefont descriptors rasterise it at build time and the compiled SpriteFont is what ships; the .ttf is a build input that is committed so the glyphs come from this repository rather than from whatever the build machine has installed (HOUSE-00200).

origin.name: Noto Sans Regular 2.015
origin.author: The Noto Project Authors
origin.note: The UI face. UNMODIFIED release artifact, member 'NotoSans/hinted/ttf/NotoSans-Regular.ttf' of the official NotoSans-v2.015 release zip; byte-identical to the same path in notofonts.github.io, so two official distribution points agree. The 'hinted' build is chosen over 'unhinted' on measured grounds: the two carry IDENTICAL outlines and hmtx and differ only in the four hinting tables and 2 995 glyph programs, and the compiled .cnb bytes differ between them -- so FreeType's bytecode interpreter is live here and the project's own ttfautohint instructions are genuinely consumed at 13-30 px. 'full' was rejected: 631 extra glyphs we never rasterise. No Reserved Font Name is declared, so OFL 1.1 clause 5 does not restrict the name. 'Noto' is a Google LLC trademark, which constrains a MODIFIED version's branding; we ship it unmodified and do not use the name for this product, so it does not bite. See docs/font-provenance.md.

origin.name: content smoke-scene clip
origin.note: Generated by tools/assets/make_smoke_assets.py for HOUSE-00201. 64x64, 2 s, 10 fps Theora + Vorbis, every frame distinct. NOT byte-reproducible across ffmpeg builds -- Theora's bitstream depends on the encoder -- so the committed file is authoritative and --check reports rather than gates.
